overview: The board approved a Chapter 40B comprehensive permit for a 289-unit residential project at 970 Fellsway and amended a height variance to facilitate redevelopment of 400 Mystic Avenue as an auto dealership. Variances were also granted for residential properties on Fulton Street and Norwich Circle, while hearings on three other properties were continued.

items.title: 360 Salem Street continuance
items.summary: Continued to June 27 to allow the petitioner to go before the Community Development Board prior to zoning review.

items.title: 278–282 Mystic Avenue comprehensive permit
items.summary: The board voted to require the applicant to pay peer review fees by June 6, found the applicant had not been responsive, and continued the 40B comprehensive permit hearing to July 25.

items.title: 970 Fellsway comprehensive permit
items.summary: Approved the Chapter 40B comprehensive permit for a 289-unit residential development, granting a partial linkage fee waiver of $816,564.24 based on proposed off-site public improvements and settling final conditions regarding peer review costs and transit infrastructure.

items.title: 28 Winford Way fence variance
items.summary: Continued to June 27 to allow the applicant to meet with abutting neighbors and submit formal plans detailing specific fence height reductions.

items.title: 178 Fulton Street curb cut and driveway variance
items.summary: Approved a variance for a new front yard curb cut and paver driveway following confirmation that the city engineering department had no objections.

items.title: 65 Sydney Street shed variance
items.summary: Continued to June 27 because the applicant was not present.

items.title: 400 Mystic Avenue height variance amendment
items.summary: Approved an amendment to a 2001 height variance to allow the demolition of a three-story building and construction of a new 50.5-foot, three-story service facility and car elevator for an auto dealership.

items.title: 110 Norwich Circle parking variance
items.summary: Approved a variance reducing required on-site parking to one non-conforming front yard space to enable construction of a residential addition.

items.title: Administrative updates
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on pending city council zoning amendments referred to the Community Development Board and discussed new transcription tools being used for meeting minutes.
